quarterly_data.signal: Vertex's July 6, 2026 Crinetics acquisition investor presentation (Exhibit 99.1) describes PALSONIFY (paltusotine) as the first and only once-daily oral therapy for adults with acromegaly (company claim), FDA and EMA approved, with a U.S. launch in October 2025 and strong early uptake. It cites PATHFNDR-1 (switch patients from injected depot SRLs) and PATHFNDR-2 (naive/untreated patients), with patients with IGF-1 <=1x ULN as primary endpoint, 2-4 weeks to IGF-1 normalization in most patients, no serious AEs and improvement on patient-reported outcomes. Based on Q1:26 data PALSONIFY has ~40-50% new to brand Rx share, is on track to achieve 75% reimbursement coverage by Q3:26, and has ~80% endo unaided awareness with ~70% of endos saying they have a high intent to prescribe. The deck sizes acromegaly at ~20,000 diagnosed patients in the U.S. and another 35,000+ outside the U.S., and says only 18% of patients remain on injectable SRLs at ~3 years.
quarterly_data.figure: U.S. launch October 2025; ~40-50% new to brand Rx share (Q1:26); 75% reimbursement coverage targeted by Q3:26; ~20,000 U.S. and 35,000+ ex-U.S. acromegaly patients

quarterly_data.signal: The same presentation says atumelnant, a once-daily oral ACTH receptor antagonist, is in Phase 3 for adults and Phase 2/3 for pediatric patients with congenital adrenal hyperplasia (CAH), and that in Phase 2 it drove robust A4 reduction, sustained even with glucocorticoids reduced to physiologic levels. In ACTH-dependent Cushing's syndrome (ADCS) atumelnant Phase 1/2 data show rapid lowering of urine free cortisol (UFC), plus early indications of potential improvement in symptoms of hypercortisolism, and it was well tolerated. Vertex sizes classic CAH at ~17,000 diagnosed U.S. patients (~12,000 adults / ~5,000 pediatrics) plus 15,000+ outside the U.S., and ADCS at >10,000 U.S. patients plus ~15,000 outside the U.S.
quarterly_data.figure: CAH: Phase 3 adults, Phase 2/3 pediatric; ~17,000 U.S. classic CAH patients plus 15,000+ ex-U.S.; ADCS >10,000 U.S. plus ~15,000 ex-U.S.

quarterly_data.signal: Vertex describes Crinetics as ~600 employees, founded 2008 and headquartered in San Diego, with a GPCR drug discovery platform, IP protection into the 2040s and additional pre-clinical pipeline assets with potential in thyroid eye disease, Graves' disease and hyperparathyroidism. Vertex says its 2023 goal of "5 launches in 5 years" is achieved early with the Crinetics acquisition, which adds endocrine as a fifth pillar.
quarterly_data.figure: ~600 employees; IP protection into 2040s; 2023 goal of 5 launches in 5 years achieved early
